overview: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM) is a nodal agency of the Government of Kerala for entrepreneurship development and incubation activities in Kerala, India. It provides a comprehensive ecosystem of support including funding schemes, incubation, acceleration, mentorship, market access, and investor connections to nurture startups from idea to scale-up stages. KSUM aims to foster innovation, promote inclusive entrepreneurship, and strengthen Kerala's position as a leading startup destination through structured programs and strategic partnerships.
objectives: Foster innovation and support entrepreneurs across all stages of their journey
Create a highly sustainable startup ecosystem under the aegis of the Govt. of Kerala
Provide access to markets, capital, partnerships, and growth opportunities
Nurture technology-driven and innovative solutions with strong commercialization potential
Enable inclusive access to capital for first-time founders, student innovators, women-led startups, and technology-driven ventures
Strengthen representation within Kerala’s startup ecosystem for Backward Classes and women/transgender founders
Facilitate structured collaboration between corporates and startups to accelerate innovation adoption
Empower women and transgender-led startups to transform their MVP into market-ready products
eligibility: Eligibility varies by scheme but generally requires startup incorporation in Kerala as a Private Limited Company, LLP, or OPC with active MCA status, DPIIT recognition, and a valid KSUM Unique ID. Specific criteria include: Idea Grant – startups at ideation, designing, or PoC stage; Productization Grant – startups in product development stage with innovative technology product; Market Acceleration Grant – startups in early revenue stage; Scale-up Grant – startups with ₹10 lakhs revenue in last 6 months or ₹30 lakhs external equity; Women/Transgender Productization Grant – women/transgender founders holding ≥51% shareholding; Seed Fund – LLP or Pvt. Ltd with active KSUM Unique ID and DIPP registration; NIDHI Seed Support – DPIIT-recognized startup with ≥3 months association in incubator, ≥51% Indian promoter shareholding; Innovation Grant – innovator based in/out of Kerala, company incorporation and KSUM Unique ID mandatory for disbursement; Women Soft Loan – registered company in Kerala as LLP or Pvt. Ltd, active KSUM Unique ID, DIPP registration, innovative product/technology, no pending dues, CIBIL score >750 preferred.
benefits: KSUM offers financial and non-financial benefits including: Idea Grant (up to ₹3 lakhs), Productization Grant (up to ₹7 lakhs), Women/Transgender Productization Grant (up to ₹12 lakhs), Market Acceleration Grant (up to ₹10 lakhs), Scale-up Grant (up to ₹15 lakhs), Innovation Grant (up to ₹15 lakhs for startups, ₹20 lakhs for women startups), Seed Fund (loan up to ₹15 lakhs), Women Soft Loan (up to ₹15 lakhs), NIDHI Seed Support (₹25 lakhs to ₹1 Crore), R&D Grant (up to ₹30 lakhs), Patent Reimbursement (₹2 lakhs national, ₹10 lakhs international), Technology Transfer Scheme (up to ₹10 lakhs), incubation and acceleration programs, mentorship from industry experts, access to world-class infrastructure (Integrated Startup Complex, Super Fablab, Digital Hub, Emerging Tech Hub, Startup Pod, Freedom Square), coworking spaces (LEAP Centres), market expansion initiatives, investor connect programs (Investor Café, Pitch Days, VC 101 Bootcamp), investor education (Ignite), Fund of Funds for capital deployment into SEBI-registered AIFs, Creative Economy Fund, government as marketplace for procurement, and international exposure programs.
financial_support: Financial support includes grants, loans, and equity-linked instruments. Grants range from ₹2 lakhs (Student Idea Grant) to ₹30 lakhs (R&D Grant). Loans include Seed Fund (up to ₹15 lakhs at 6% simple interest with 12-month moratorium and 36-month repayment), Women Soft Loan (up to ₹15 lakhs at 6% simple interest repayable in 1 year or project completion), and Scale-up Seed Fund (collateral-free debt or CCD/CCPS up to ₹25 lakhs at 6% simple interest with 12-month moratorium and 36-month repayment). The Fund of Funds deploys capital as a Limited Partner in SEBI-registered AIFs that invest in Kerala-based startups. The Innovation Grant provides up to ₹15 lakhs for startups and ₹20 lakhs for women startups. Specific grants: Idea Grant (₹3 lakhs), Productization Grant (₹7 lakhs), Market Acceleration Grant (₹10 lakhs), Scale-up Grant (₹15 lakhs), Women/Transgender Productization Grant (₹12 lakhs), NIDHI Prayas Grant (₹10 lakhs), NIDHI Seed Support (₹25 lakhs–1 Crore), R&D Grant (₹30 lakhs).
grant_amount_per_entity: Up to ₹30 lakhs for R&D Grant
application_process: 1. Visit the KSUM website at https://startupmission.kerala.gov.in 2. Navigate to the 'Schemes' section and select the relevant scheme 3. Download the guideline document for detailed eligibility and process 4. Check for open application calls published on the website, social media, and print media 5. Submit application online through the KSUM portal during the application window 6. Fill the application form and upload required documents (incorporation, PAN, KSUM Unique ID, bank details, fund utilization plan, etc.) 7. Application scrutiny by KSUM officials 8. Shortlisting based on eligibility and proposal merit 9. Pitch presentation before the Expert Committee 10. Evaluation based on team, product innovation, marketing, financials, and fund utilization plan 11. Approval by CEO/Chairman, KSUM 12. Agreement execution with KSUM 13. Fund disbursement in milestone-based tranches (typically 50% first tranche, balance after progress review and utilization certificate)
required_documents: Rs.200 worth Stamp paper in the name of the company
Documents in connection with Revenue generation/Investment raised
Company Balance sheet for the last two years
Project plan with milestones and time frame
Progress report and utilisation certificate for subsequent tranches
Undertaking on current litigation or arbitration
Space utilization plan (for space allotment EOI)
deadlines: Rolling basis — application windows are announced periodically through KSUM’s website, social media, and print media. Specific schemes like Innovation Grant are conducted under 'Kerala Innovation Drive’YY’ annually or as per demand. EOIs and tenders have fixed closing dates (e.g., EOI for Startup Space Allotment: 22 June 2026 at 5:00 PM; Tender for AutoCAD: 13 July 2026 at 5:00 PM).
implementing_agency: Kerala Startup Mission (KSUM), nodal agency of the Government of Kerala for entrepreneurship development and incubation activities

caveats: Grants are not given for service startups and SMEs working in trade and commerce
Startups shall not have any other pending dues with Government agencies, KSUM, or other incubators
Startups shall not be blacklisted by any Govt. agency in India
Founder salaries, purchase of fixed assets (land, building, high-end equipment, costly software above ₹2 lakhs), rent, and major infrastructure setup are not permitted under most grants
Only one idea can be applied for at a time; two grants will not be sanctioned simultaneously
If a startup has availed prior grants (Idea, Productization, Market Acceleration), only the remaining eligible amount can be claimed for subsequent grants
KSUM Unique ID is mandatory for fund disbursement (though not always for application)
Company incorporation and active MCA status are mandatory before fund disbursal
Women/Transgender Productization Grant is not available to startups that have already received Scale-up Grant
NIDHI Seed Support is not meant for Indian subsidiaries of MNCs/foreign companies
Shareholding by Indian promoters in incubated startup must be at least 51%
Preference given to startups that have not availed funding from any Government of India/State Govt. body
Fund disbursement is on an installment basis subject to milestone completion and utilization certificate submission
Repayment of loans begins after moratorium period; prepayment allowed without penalty
Margin money (20%-50% of grant amount) is required for most grants
The Fund of Funds invests as a Limited Partner in SEBI-registered AIFs, not directly in startups
Ignite program is for HNIs and UHNIs only, not startups
Creative Economy Fund is a proposed initiative (Coming Soon)
Some schemes like NIDHI Prayas Grant and Technology Transfer Scheme are marked 'Coming Soon'
Application may be rejected if documents are incomplete or not in prescribed format
KSUM reserves the right to reject applications without assigning reasons
Tender/EOI processes require hardcopy submission and adherence to strict timelines
Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) is forfeited if bidder withdraws after opening or fails to sign contract
Tender validity is typically 90 days from date of opening
Defects Liability Period for works contracts is 18 months
Liquidated damages: 0.5% of contract value per week of delay (max 5%)
KSUM may cancel, withdraw, or modify tenders/EOIs at any stage without assigning reason
